material.title: Left joins

sections.heading: Preserve left rows
sections.body: A left join retains every left-table row. Unmatched right-side columns are NULL. An inner join retains only matching pairs.

material.example: A customer without orders appears in a customer LEFT JOIN orders result with NULL order fields.

self_checks.question: Which rows are kept by a left join?
